内膜、周质和外膜围成细胞的边界。剖切后可观察内部结构。: The inner membrane, periplasm and outer membrane form the cell boundary. Cut away the envelope to see inside.

选中后按 mRNA、tRNA、rRNA 与其他 RNA 区分颜色；分类质量来自模: Selection colors distinguish mRNA, tRNA, rRNA and other RNA using model class masses. The rRNA glyph positions do not imply a free, unbound state.
蛋白质按代表性结构展示。选中后区分十个目标基因的蛋白质及其他蛋白质。: Representative protein shapes. Selection distinguishes proteins from ten target genes and all other proteins.
胞质小分子；当前数值为 ATP 分子数。: Cytoplasmic small molecules; the displayed value counts ATP molecules.
细胞干质量随时间的变化，不包含水分。质量来自模型的 mass listener。: Cell dry mass over time, excluding water, from the model mass listener.
所有 mRNA 转录单元的分子数总和。可同时观察活跃 RNA 聚合酶与 RNA: Total molecules across mRNA transcription units, alongside active RNA polymerases and RNA mass.
当前参与蛋白质合成的活跃核糖体数量。三维场景中的核糖体是代表性抽样。: Active ribosomes currently synthesizing proteins. The 3D view uses representative samples.
胞质 ATP 的分子计数。这不是百分比能量值；ATP 与 ADP 均来自 bul: Cytoplasmic ATP molecule count, not an energy percentage. ATP and ADP come from the bulk pool.

官方支持指定代次诱导新基因、调节表达和翻译效率；需要新基因参数及多代谱系，暂未接: The official variant can induce new genes at selected generations and change expression and translation efficiency. It requires new-gene parameters and multi-generation lineages, and is not yet connected here.
比较碳源如何影响生长、ATP 和蛋白质合成。: Compare how carbon sources affect growth, ATP and protein synthesis.
比较营养补充或缺氧下的细胞活动。: Compare cellular activity with nutrient supplementation or without oxygen.
葡萄糖-6-磷酸异构酶；观察糖代谢分流。: Glucose-6-phosphate isomerase; explore central carbon routing.
丙酮酸激酶 I；连接糖酵解与 ATP 生成。: Pyruvate kinase I; connects glycolysis and ATP production.
葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶；参与 NADPH 供应。: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase; contributes to NADPH supply.
柠檬酸合酶；连接乙酰辅酶 A 与三羧酸循环。: Citrate synthase; connects acetyl-CoA to the TCA cycle.
葡萄糖 PTS 转运组分；观察营养摄取相关变化。: Glucose PTS transport component; explore nutrient uptake.
二氢叶酸还原酶；参与核苷酸合成所需的叶酸循环。: Dihydrofolate reductase; supports folate-dependent nucleotide synthesis.
DNA 旋转酶 A 亚基；可跟踪表达量，模型不直接预测三维超螺旋。: DNA gyrase subunit A; track expression, without claiming a 3D supercoiling prediction.
烯酰载体蛋白还原酶；参与膜脂前体合成。: Enoyl-ACP reductase; contributes to membrane lipid precursor synthesis.

粒子位置和区域来自官方 LM 文件。多个粒子可占据同一格点；不添加随机位移，不在: Particle locations and regions come from the official LM files. Co-located particles are preserved, with no random displacement or temporal interpolation. DNA shows occupancy voxels, without inventing unpublished chain coordinates. Shapes and materials are visual symbols; exploding changes positions only for inspection. Nonspatial quantities such as ATP come from exactly matched count traces. After division, the view may contain both daughters and quantities cover the entire simulation domain.
